statement.essentials: Surgeons usually find the main trunk of the nerve first, then follow it forward, lifting the gland off the nerve branch by branch.
statement.anatomy: In antegrade dissection the trunk is identified using landmarks and stimulation, followed to the pes, and the tissue overlying each branch is tunnelled and divided; a retrograde approach from a peripheral branch is an alternative.

limitations: Sequence and instruments vary; shown here as one representative approach.
